question: ¿Cuántos ensayos de fase 3 (incluye fase 2/3) de cáncer de mama prueban alguna terapia dirigida?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
JOIN linking.trial_condition tc ON tc.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
JOIN mesh.descriptor d ON d.id = a.ancestor_id AND d.label = 'Breast Neoplasms'
JOIN linking.trial_drug td ON td.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN linking.drug_class dc ON dc.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id AND dc.class IN ('KinaseInhibitor','MonoclonalAntibody')
WHERE s.phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
